title: Posted Schedule: The Administrative Fee on a Buyout, by the Work Already Done on the Contract
content:
The administrative fee on a buyout under Grain Marketing Contracts follows the work the desk has already done on the contract.

| The contract | Administrative fee |
|---|---|
| Carries a registered amendment, and loads the member directed to the contract at the scale stand applied to it | 275.00 |
| Carries such loads applied to it, but no amendment registered against it | 140.00 |
| Carries no such load applied | the flat administrative fee the member's marketing programme carries |

## Which loads are counted

Only the loads the member directed to the contract at the scale are counted here. A load the member ran straight through to the buyer is not such a load, and a contract carrying only straight-through loads carries no load applied for the purposes of this fee.

## The conditions read apart

The first band asks for both: at least one amendment registered against the contract and at least one such load applied to it. A contract carrying an amendment but no such load applied falls to the third band, not the first, because the third band asks only that no such load stands applied. A contract carrying such loads and no amendment falls to the second band.

| Amendments registered | Such loads applied | Fee |
|---|---|---|
| 1 or more | 1 or more | 275.00 |
| none | 1 or more | 140.00 |
| 1 or more | none | the flat fee the marketing programme carries |
| none | none | the flat fee the marketing programme carries |

## Illustration on hypothetical figures

A contract with two amendments registered and five loads the member directed to it at the scale carries a fee of 275.00. The same contract with those five loads and no amendment carries 140.00. With no such load applied at all, whatever amendments stand, the fee is the flat administrative fee its marketing programme carries.
